后坐补偿在 Aimbot 页设置。: Adjust recoil compensation on the Aimbot tab.
启用前先关闭其他已开启的 Aim 功能。启用后仍需按住所设侧键进行瞄准；关闭时停: Disables other active Aim features before enabling Aimbot. Hold the configured side button to aim. Disabling stops tracking and clears the current target lock.
启用前先关闭 Aimbot 和 Rage。启用后持续检测，不需要按住侧键；不会移: Disables Aimbot and Rage before enabling Triggerbot. Detection runs without holding a side button or moving the crosshair. Foreground checking follows Aim General settings.
启用时关闭 Aimbot 和 Triggerbot。前台检查遵循 Aim 常规设: Turns off Aimbot and Triggerbot. Foreground checking follows Aim General settings.
按住跟随侧键即可补偿后坐。有目标时随目标调整。无目标时按手动瞄准的方向补偿，移动: Hold the same side button to compensate for recoil. With a target, follow the target. Without a target, steer the aiming direction with your mouse. This switch also controls recoil compensation in Rage.
无可用目标，按住侧键可补偿后坐: No target available. Hold the side button to compensate for recoil.
正在补偿后坐，瞄准方向由鼠标控制: Compensating for recoil. Steer with your mouse.
v1 去原生眼角: v1 without the native eye basis
选择单变量组时固定使用v1基线，不叠加v2/v3策略；完整v1数据资格和选人保持: Comparisons use the v1 baseline without stacking v2/v3 strategies. Full v1 data qualification and target selection stay unchanged.
当前相关功能未启用或没有待反馈位移，本组可能暂时没有差异；无差异不能证明该因素无: The related feature is off or there is no pending motion. This comparison may currently make no difference; that does not prove the factor is irrelevant.
完整v1数据仍用于资格与基线选人，实际控制只改变标明的一项。原始字段仍被读取，不: Complete v1 data still qualifies and selects the baseline target. Only the declared computation changes. A field can remain read for qualification without contributing to this comparison’s error. Missing data never relaxes checks or switches the target.
保留 v1 的后坐、眼角和时间求值，完整剩余角差直接换算为设备计数，不再经过追踪: Keeps v1 recoil, eye basis and timing. The entire remaining angle maps directly to device counts without tracking gain, start/stop acceleration or learned variation.
扣除已接受待反映位移后，完整角差按最近计数量化，尽量在当前速度、学习模型速度上限: After subtracting accepted motion not yet expected in the sample, quantizes the whole residual to the nearest count within current speed, learned speed and device budgets. Retains the half-count/0.01° dead zone and rate remainder. Fractional error remains in the next current residual rather than accumulating old data again.
预计执行延迟、P/U求值和反馈账本保持当前设置；仅更换运动方式，便于比较平滑的影: Response delay, P/U evaluation and the feedback ledger keep current settings. Only motion generation changes to compare smoothing. Identity, side-key, data qualification and same-target recovery remain. Rejected proposals refund the rate budget.
以 v1 为基线，将方向参考改为 Local.input_view_angles: Uses v1 with Local.input_view_angles (dwViewAngles) as the direction reference. P/U, time compensation and original smoothing remain.
控制计算与响应核对均使用全局输入角，不使用eye_basis、Pawn v_an: Both control and response checks use global input angles without eye_basis, Pawn v_angle, network m_angEyeAngles or matching eye-group selectors. World eye position still anchors geometry. Missing global input angles stop control without a native-eye fallback.
保留 v1 全部 P/U 后坐求值、时间与速度补偿、设备换算、平滑和停止规则；完: Keeps v1 P/U evaluation, timing, velocity, count mapping, smoothing and stopping. Complete recoil data remains required. Assumes global input plus P/U can be a world shot reference; equivalence to every native parent/history route is not established. This version compares the eye-reference dependency.
v4使用全局输入视角加同一P/U求值，不使用原生eye_basis或Pawn v: v4 uses global input angles plus the same P/U evaluation without native eye_basis or Pawn v_angle. This is an experimental direction-reference model.
角差参考改为全局输入角: Use global input for the error basis
只替换控制角差基准为dwViewAngles；原生眼角资格、v1选人与响应观察不: Replaces only the error’s direction basis with dwViewAngles. Native-eye qualification, v1 target selection and response observation remain, unlike v4’s whole dependency removal.
两种角度实际不同时才有数值差异。: The two angle values must differ to change the numeric result.
实际发射参考只关闭P分量；U、原生E规则、完整数据资格和v1选人不变。: Removes only P from the actual shot reference. U, native E, full qualification and v1 target selection remain.
后坐补偿开启且P分量非零时有效。: Recoil compensation must be on and P nonzero.
只将实际P求值的基准角置零，保留角速度、时间、U与E规则；原始P仍用于基线资格和: Zeros only the P base angle in actual evaluation; velocity, time, U and E remain. The original P still qualifies and selects the baseline target.
后坐补偿开启且P基准角非零时有效。: Recoil compensation must be on and the P base angle nonzero.
只将实际P求值的基准角速度置零，保留基准角、时间、U和原生E规则。: Zeros only P base angular velocity; base angle, time, U and native E remain.
后坐补偿开启且P角速度对当前求值有贡献时有效。: Recoil compensation must be on and P velocity must contribute at the evaluation time.
实际发射参考只关闭U分量；P、完整数据资格和v1选人不变。: Removes only U from the actual reference. P, complete qualification and v1 selection remain.
后坐补偿开启且U分量非零时有效。: Recoil compensation must be on and U nonzero.
不平移目标位置: Do not advance the target position
只关闭目标世界速度造成的位置提前量，自身运动、时间窗口和后坐外推不变。: Removes only target-velocity lead. Self motion, time horizon and recoil extrapolation remain.
速度预测开启且目标运动时有效。: Velocity prediction must be on and the target moving.
不平移自身位置: Do not advance the self position
只关闭自身世界速度造成的眼部位置平移，目标运动、时间窗口和后坐外推不变。: Removes only self-velocity eye-position lead. Target motion, horizon and recoil extrapolation remain.
速度预测开启且自身运动时有效。: Velocity prediction must be on and the local player moving.
只从预测窗口去掉采样年龄；仍检查真实年龄是否过期，预计执行延迟和反馈账本规则不变: Removes only sample age from the prediction horizon. Actual age still qualifies freshness; response delay and the ledger remain unchanged.
样本有年龄，且运动预测或后坐外推会改变结果时有效。: The sample must have age, and motion or recoil extrapolation must affect the result.
只从预测窗口去掉预计执行延迟；读取年龄保留，反馈账本仍使用原响应模型。: Removes only response delay from the prediction horizon. Sample age stays and the ledger uses the original response model.
预计执行延迟大于0且预测会改变结果时有效。: Response delay must exceed zero and prediction must affect the result.
后坐只在采样时刻求值: Evaluate recoil only at sample time
只将P/U求值时刻固定在本批simulation，不向执行时刻推进；敌我运动预测: Evaluates P/U only at this batch’s simulation time without advancing it. Geometry prediction stays unchanged.
后坐补偿开启且P/U随时间变化时有效。: Recoil compensation must be on and P/U changing over time.
只关闭角差中的待反映位移扣除；账本记录、超时观察、来源复核和设备约束照常运行。: Disables only pending-motion subtraction from the error. Records, timeouts, source checks and device limits remain active.
有已接受但预计尚未反映到采样的位移时有效，静止无输出时应无差异。: Accepted motion must be pending its expected sample reflection. Idle/no-output operation should be unchanged.
只移除剩余计数乘比例增益的速度上限，保留速度、加减速和停止距离约束。: Removes only remaining counts times gain from desired speed. Speed, acceleration and braking limits remain.
比例项是当前最紧约束时有效。: The proportional term must be the binding constraint.
只让速度直接达到本步需求值；比例、速度上限与停止距离仍保留。: Sets velocity directly to this step’s demand. Proportional, speed and stopping-distance limits remain.
启动、停止或转向时，加减速限幅原本生效才有差异。: Acceleration limiting must be active during starting, stopping or turning.
只移除sqrt(2×加速度×剩余计数)上限，保留比例、速度与加减速约束。: Removes only sqrt(2 × acceleration × remaining counts). Proportional, speed and acceleration limits remain.
接近目标且停止距离约束原本生效时有效。: Stopping distance must be binding near the target.
只关闭HumanMotionRuntime的横向微扰；模型速度和加减速上限不变。: Disables only HumanMotionRuntime lateral variation. Learned speed and acceleration limits remain.
微扰开关开启、角差大于0.6°且剩余计数距离足够时有效。: Variation must be enabled, angular error above 0.6°, and remaining count distance sufficient.
只关闭模型速度、加速度和制动上限，保留设备/档位约束；微扰设置不变。: Disables only learned speed, acceleration and braking limits. Device/preset limits and variation remain.
模型启用且其上限比设备/档位约束更紧时有效。: An enabled model must impose tighter limits than the device/preset.
v1保留PC2.2.4合并误差平滑；v2独立处理已知后坐变化；v3直接量化完整剩: v1 preserves PC2.2.4 combined-error smoothing; v2 separately handles known recoil changes; v3 directly quantizes the entire residual; v4 uses global input plus P/U with v1 motion. Each single-factor comparison retains v1 qualification and target selection and changes only its registered computation. Device budgets and session checks remain. Stable IDs persist per game; switching clears old state. Actual effects require user comparison.
对照组固定使用完整v1数据完成资格与选人，再对同一当前目标仅改变登记的一项策略；: Complete v1 data qualifies and selects the same current target before only one registered factor changes. Missing fields never relax checks, and v2/v3 strategies do not stack. No difference without the effective conditions does not prove irrelevance. Native E definitions, session, side-key, identity and device capabilities stay fixed. See the version panel for the change, fields and conditions.
后坐变化优先使用独立计数通道，平滑跟随只处理扣除该部分后的剩余角差，全部已接受位: Recoil changes use a separate count channel before the remaining tracking error is smoothed. All accepted motion shares one ledger. The first lock or a discontinuous time route rebuilds the difference reference; unsupported local prediction and compensation-off use baseline motion. Rejected proposals roll back fast state and fractional budget without resetting accepted tracking state. Side-key, session and source checks remain.
完整剩余角差在扣除待反馈位移后直接按最近计数量化，跳过比例追赶、加减速与学习微扰: After subtracting pending motion, directly quantizes the entire remaining angle to the nearest count without proportional tracking, acceleration or lateral variation. Current speed, learned speed limit, dead zone and device budgets remain. Fractional error stays in the current residual; rejected proposals refund the rate budget.
单变量组使用同一个v1运动内核，只修改登记的一个因子；若变量属于运动模块，仅关闭: Each comparison uses the same v1 motion kernel and changes one registered factor. A motion comparison removes only its named constraint or variation. Other motion factors, device budgets and output qualification remain; see the version panel for conditions.
方向计算使用Local.input_view_angles（dwViewAngl: Direction uses Local.input_view_angles (dwViewAngles) plus current P/U, rather than Reader-evaluated native eye_basis. v4 removes native-eye qualification and response dependencies too. The single-factor direction comparison changes only the error reference and keeps v1 qualification, target selection and response observation.
v4要求普通本地角色、全局输入角、完整P/U和可信时间；控制与响应都不依赖eye: v4 requires an ordinary local player, global input angles, complete P/U and trusted timing. Control and response do not depend on eye_basis/Pawn.v_angle. Global input plus P/U is an experimental reference, not proven equivalent to every native parent transform or historical route. Identity, side-key, death and device checks remain.
读取年龄资格保持v1；采样年龄、预计执行延迟和P/U求值推进为独立因子。对照只改: Sample-age qualification stays at v1. Sample age, expected execution delay and P/U evaluation advance are independent factors. Only the selected contribution changes; the ledger response configuration stays fixed. Runtime displays geometry and recoil horizons separately.
有符号角差按明确的原生1:1公式或已采用实测比值换算；所有模式受握手速度、步长和: Signed angular error maps through the explicit native 1:1 assumption or an adopted measured ratio. All modes obey negotiated speed, step and count budgets. The selected mode states whether smoothing, prediction and lateral variation participate.
